name: Room items and acceptance: a person decides a candidate requirement, decision or question
aliases: accept reject amend a room item
room decision item to native decision
summary: Slice 2 of project rooms. Item and item-event lines in the append-only room files; states proposed, accepted, rejected, amended, superseded; accept/reject/amend/answer by a signed-in person only (R7, never an agent credential). A requirement-editor accept creates and accepts a requirement through the B1 routes; a contributor accept submits a requirement proposal as that person; a decision accept creates the native decision through the service-only room-decision action, which re-checks live owner/coordinator membership and the item's room, title, text and evidence in the endpoint before a guarded write; a question answer stays a room item with who and when. Rejecting or amending needs the item author or an owner/coordinator; answering a question is a member action. The pointer orchestra:room/<room-id>#<seq> rides only in an existing description, proposal evidence list or decision rationale; no record shape changes and no source field. A stable item identity and a project item-decision lock make one record per item; a derived items cache in index.json rebuilds identically from the segment lines; a moderated item's title, text and every user-written event field are served nowhere.
